ML Phase uses the analysis, delay and fractional interpolation modules from Michael Jancsy's ConjureAlign, revision c978f0c3919edabd64c81cd01a91818a6dd53507, GPL-3.0-or-later. https://github.com/michaeljancsy/ConjureAlign

ML adaptations: native stock editor and host integration, fixed latency, capture workflow, and linear tap crossfades to avoid correlated-signal gain boosts. Original product networking, analytics and updater modules are not included.
